class Edge:
        def __init__(self, v, c):
                self.v = v
                self.c = c

class FlowNetwork:
        def __init__(self):
                self.n = 0
                self.m = 0
                self.source = 0
                self.sink = 0
                self.e = [[] for _ in range(300)]
                self.edge = [None for _ in range(131072)]

        def init(self, n, source, sink):
                self.n = n
                self.m = 0
                self.source = source
                self.sink = sink
                for i in range(n):
                        self.e[i].clear()

        def addEdge(self, a, b, c):
                self.edge[self.m] = Edge(b, c)
                self.e[a].append(self.m)
                self.edge[self.m + 1] = Edge(a, 0)
                self.e[b].append(self.m + 1)
                self.m += 2

        def _bfs(self):
                q = deque()
                c = [0 for _ in range(self.n)]
                d = [self.n for _ in range(self.n)]
                d[self.sink] = 0
                q.append(self.sink)
                while q:
                        cur = q.popleft()
                        c[d[cur]] += 1
                        for i in range(len(self.e[cur])):
                                id = self.e[cur][i]
                                if d[self.edge[id].v] == self.n and self.edge[~id].c > 0:
                                        d[self.edge[id].v] = d[cur] + 1
                                        q.append(self.edge[id].v)
                return c, d

        def _retreat(self, v):
                c[d[v]] -= 1
                d[v] = self.n
                for i in range(len(self.e[v])):
                        if d[v] > d[self.edge[i].v] + 1 and self.edge[i].c > 0:
                                d[v] = d[self.edge[i].v] + 1
                                self.done[v] = i
                c[d[v]] += 1

        def _augment(self):
                todo = -1
                flow = 0x7fffff
                for i in range(self.len):
                        if self.edge[self.e[self.path[i]][self.done[self.path[i]]]].c < flow:
                                flow = self.edge[self.e[self.path[i]][self.done[self.path[i]]]].c
                                todo = i

                        id = self.e[self.path[i]][self.done[self.path[i]]]
                        self.edge[id].c -= flow
                        self.edge[~id].c += flow
                self.len = todo
                return flow

                flow = 0
                c, d = self._bfs()
                self.done = [0 for _ in range(self.n)]

                                        if d[self.edge[self.e[back][self.done[back]]].v] == d[back] - 1 and self.edge[self.e[back][self.done[back]]].c > 0:
                                                break
                                        else:
                                                self.done[back] += 1
                                if self.done[back] == len(self.e[back]):
                                        if c[d[back]] == 1:
                                                break
                                        else:
                                                self._retreat(back)
                                                if back != self.source:
                                                        self.len -= 1
                                else:
                                        self.path[self.len + 1] = self.edge[self.e[back][self.done[back]]].v
                                        self.len += 1
                return flow

        def bfs(self, n):

                for i in range(n):

                                        self.d[xx][yy] = self.d[x][y] + 1
                                        q.append((xx, yy))

        def gao(self, n, m, sx, sy):
                q = deque()
                for i in range(n):

                                self.t[i][j] = 10**9
                q.append((sx, sy))
                self.t[sx][sy] = 0
                while q:

                        if self.t[x][y] <= self.d[x][y] and self.sci[x][y].isdigit() and self.sci[x][y] != '0':

                                        self.t[xx][yy] = self.t[x][y] + 1
